# Marrakech Eco Tours

> Licensed Moroccan tour operator offering small-group, eco-conscious adventures led by certified Berber guides. Founded in 2010 by the Aitidar family. Based in Marrakech, Morocco.

## About

Marrakech Eco Tours was founded in 2010 by brothers Smail and Mohamed Aitidar, sons of Lahsen Aitidar — one of the first licensed Berber mountain guides in the High Atlas. All guides hold Moroccan Ministry of Tourism certifications.

Tours depart from Marrakech and Agadir. Group sizes are small (2–15 people). Private and custom departures available. Leave No Trace practices are followed on all trips.

- Languages: Arabic, Berber (Tachelhit), French, English, Spanish
- Rating: 5.0/5 on TripAdvisor (122 reviews); 1,000+ travellers hosted
- Phone / WhatsApp: +212 653 936 003
- Site languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Arabic

## Signature tours

- [Toubkal Summit Trek, 4 days](https://marrakechecotours.com/en/tours/toubkal-summit-trek-4day): climb Jbel Toubkal (4,167 m), the highest peak in North Africa, with an acclimatisation day
- [Mount Toubkal Express, 2 days](https://marrakechecotours.com/en/tours/toubkal-summit-2day-marrakech): the fastest route to the summit from Marrakech — refuge overnight, pre-dawn ascent
- [Sahara Desert Tour, 3 days](https://marrakechecotours.com/en/tours/sahara-3day-marrakech): camel trek, Berber desert camp, Erg Chebbi dunes and Aït Ben Haddou
- [Merzouga Stargazing Desert Tour](https://marrakechecotours.com/en/tours/merzouga-stargazing-desert-tour): desert nights under the Sahara sky
- [Ourika Valley Day Hike](https://marrakechecotours.com/en/tours/ourika-valley-day-hike): Setti Fatma waterfalls, Berber villages and natural pools
- [Ouzoud Waterfalls Day Trip](https://marrakechecotours.com/en/tours/ouzoud-waterfalls-day-trip): Morocco's 110 m triple cascade and its wild Barbary macaques
- [Agafay Desert Sunset](https://marrakechecotours.com/en/tours/agafay-desert-sunset): stone desert an hour from Marrakech, camels and a Berber dinner
- [Paradise Valley from Agadir](https://marrakechecotours.com/en/tours/paradise-valley-agadir): palm gorge and spring-fed rock pools inland from the coast
- [Marrakech Medina Cultural Tour](https://marrakechecotours.com/en/tours/marrakech-medina-cultural-tour): souks, tanneries and riads with a local guide
- [High Atlas Grand Traverse, 15 days](https://marrakechecotours.com/en/tours/high-atlas-grand-traverse-15day): the full traverse, for experienced trekkers

## Key destinations covered

Atlas Mountains (Toubkal, Mgoun, Ourika, Imlil, Azzaden), Sahara Desert (Merzouga, Erg Chebbi, Erg Chegaga, Zagora), Marrakech Medina, Fes el-Bali, Chefchaouen, Essaouira, Agadir and the Souss, Ouzoud Falls, Draa Valley, Dades and Todra gorges, Aït Ben Haddou (UNESCO).
